summary.headline: Sudarshan Q4 FY26 reported EBITDA INR73 crore, business EBITDA INR118 crore; net debt cut to INR755 crore from INR934 crore in Dec-25.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 showed a sharp sequential recovery as insolvency-era customer destocking ended and volumes returned, with the acquired Heubach/Clariant pigments group delivering EUR11 million business EBITDA versus a EUR9-10 million plan. Inventory was cut by EUR29 million against a EUR20 million plan, which released INR82 crore of overhead from the balance sheet and lifted P&L EBITDA. Reported EBITDA of INR73 crore included a one-time non-cash PPA credit of INR37 crore, and depreciation fell to about INR50 crore for the quarter after the final purchase price allocation. Management guided to EUR35 million EBITDA for FY27 and reiterated EUR90-100 million over three to four years, while flagging Middle East-driven raw material, energy and logistics pressure.

segments.name: Legacy Sudarshan
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue was flattish, hit by distributor rationalisation in Europe and LatAm; integration costs slightly dented EBITDA. Management guides 8-10% growth for FY27 and expects to keep healthy margins.

segments.name: Acquired group (Heubach/Clariant pigments)
segments.commentary: Q4 business EBITDA EUR11 million, with FY26 EBITDA turning positive on value capture. Management guides EUR35 million EBITDA for FY27 and EUR90-100 million over 3-4 years. Gross margin is 4-5 percentage points above Legacy, offset by higher fixed costs.

segments.name: RIECO (engineering)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR268 crore (+17.5%) and EBITDA turned to INR10 crore from negative INR17 crore on restructuring and project cost control. Management says transformation is not finished and numbers have not improved as expected.

guidance_outlook: FY27 acquired-group EBITDA guided at EUR35 million, with only moderate growth assumed given geopolitical risk.
EUR90-100 million acquired-group EBITDA targeted over the next 3-4 years, driven by synergies, value capture and sales growth; no investment needed for that volume.
Legacy Sudarshan growth of 8-10% expected in FY27; healthy margins targeted.
Further inventory reduction of EUR15-20 million targeted; management says this is the normal level, after which reported and business EBITDA should converge.
Acquisition debt repayment is ballooning, starting FY27 and stepping up; management expects EBITDA to cover it.
Full integration benefits expected over the next two financial years; One SAP integration of 4 systems and 180 applications targeted by year-end; GCC fully operational in 6-8 months.
Tax: ETR is somewhat high for the acquired group due to conservative accounting and deferred taxes not recognised in some entities; similar range expected for FY27.
Annualised depreciation after final PPA is about INR347 crore.
capex_capacity: Enough capacity headroom in both Legacy and acquired plants to grow; the 3-4 year EBITDA plan needs no volume-driven investment.
Some commodity production moved from Frankfurt to the Indian Heubach site at Roha; Frankfurt is being kept for specialty products.
Legacy Indian plants debottlenecked after expansion; management did not give a utilisation percentage.
Management is exploring disposal of non-core assets; thinking is at an early stage.
Captive energy cost is 6-7% of revenue post-increase, per management.
demand_pricing: Q4 volumes recovered sharply; management says growth came from volume (customers ending destocking and buying again), with no price increases in Q4.
Management says Q4 was not industry growth but a recovery from winning back customers; pigment industry growth is about 3-4% globally, tracking GDP.
Near-term demand is described as muted due to the Middle East conflict, customers cutting inventory building and complementary products being unavailable; US housing and paint markets are weak.

Raw materials are petrochemical-derived, with price increases and supply constraints. Management says raw material cover is adequate and costs are being passed on region by region, though some competitors lag.
Management says it does not want to profit from price rises and is passing through only the cost increases.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the EUR29 million inventory reduction is done, and what happens to the remaining inventory?
qa_highlights.answer: The EUR29 million cut is done; a further EUR15-20 million reduction is targeted gradually, which management sees as the normal state, when reported and business EBITDA should converge.

qa_highlights.question: How will the acquisition debt be reduced given that most cash sits in India and most debt sits in the acquired entities?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said acquired-group debt will be serviced from its cash flows, and the repayment schedule is ballooning, starting this year and stepping up.

qa_highlights.question: What share of Q4 growth came from restocking versus true demand, and was it broad-based?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q4 was not restocking; customers resumed buying after destocking ended, with broad recovery across segments, mainly coatings.

qa_highlights.question: Why did depreciation fall to about INR50 crore in Q4, and what is the run rate?
qa_highlights.answer: The final PPA gave a one-time depreciation reduction after fair-valuing fixed assets; the annualised depreciation run rate is about INR347 crore.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the FY27 EUR35 million EBITDA guide comes from integration versus recovery?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is a mix of value capture and recovery, with only moderate growth assumed given the geopolitical situation.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Legacy business's healthy margin sustainable through raw material volatility?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects to maintain healthy Legacy margins by passing cost increases through to customers.

risks_watch: Middle East conflict: petrochemical raw material prices and supply, energy costs (6-7% of revenue), and logistics costs and returns are all rising.
Pass-through lag in some regions and competitor-origin countries could squeeze margins or volumes.
Debt repayment schedule is ballooning from FY27; coverage depends on the acquired EBITDA ramp to EUR35 million and beyond.
Q4 benefited from a EUR82 crore overhead release and a one-time INR37 crore PPA credit. Reported EBITDA will look weaker when inventory stops falling.
Acquired group performance depends on integration milestones: One SAP by year-end, GCC in 6-8 months.
RIECO transformation is incomplete and its numbers have lagged expectations.
Possible disposal of non-core assets is at an early stage.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Q4 execution and balance sheet, but cautious on FY27 outlook, citing geopolitical risk, raw material and energy costs and muted near-term demand. Management was evasive on the size of the FY27 volume recovery and gave no utilisation or margin numbers.
key_quotes: So I think the team has done a great job in delivering the robust performance as we say.
We are cautiously navigating the challenging working environment created by the current geopolitical situation, uncertainty resulting in logistic challenges, rising raw materials.
We don't want to profit from this situation, and we want to maintain our volumes.
